$comment: The genius in play: its orders, how it fights, how it falls, what the Tally counts from a fight, and how big it stands. The rules of its growth (instars, Resonance, shadows, slots) are in rules.json; the Reading's numbers in reading.json. Every number here is a designer's knob.

orders.name: Guard
orders.text: Stays at your side and takes the hit you did not see.

orders.name: Hunt
orders.text: Goes for the foe you are locked on to, with blows of its own.

orders.name: Hold
orders.text: Takes a position or a post and keeps it.

orders.name: Free
orders.text: Its own judgment: what it has learned from your last thirty days.

orders.name: Duet
orders.text: Joins your Pattern: the chain doubles, and the payout with it.

byExpression.$comment: How each kind of genius hunts: damage and interval multipliers.

fall.$comment: A fallen genius lies until the post, extraction or the hearth; in the practice yard it gets up after roomRecoverSeconds.

tally.$comment: Where a hit lands, in metres: closer than close is close; closer than mid is mid; past it is far.

size.$comment: How tall a genius stands, by instar, in metres.

progression.$comment: How a genius's progress shows between Readings (docs/genius-progression.md). growth: how far it grows toward the next instar's size before the Reading comes (0 none, 1 all the way). molt: its readiness for the next Reading (0 to 1: the share of the minimum days lived, 1 once the milestone is reached too) at which the molt lines begin to show along its body, and their strength when the Reading is due.
